## Description

Describe the change and its value to readers. Link related issues, if applicable.

## Verification

Explain how you checked technical accuracy, links, and any executable examples. Include relevant framework versions. For runtime claims, describe how you checked the behaviour.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] The content is original or appropriately attributed.
- [ ] I reviewed Markdown formatting, spelling, and links.
- [ ] I verified technical claims and stated relevant version assumptions.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes and the regenerated `questions/README.md` is committed.
- [ ] `npm run verify:examples` passes, or this change contains no TypeScript examples.
